title: [Update] Razorpay Gets SEBI Nod For ₹6,000 Cr IPO
summary: Update | November 14, 2026; 01:25 AM IST  Fintech major Razorpay has received Securities and Exchange Board of India’s (SEBI)…
llm_summary: Fintech powerhouse Razorpay has secured approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to launch a ₹6,000‑crore initial public offering, marking a major step toward its market debut. The green light follows recent legal setbacks, including a Karnataka High Court ruling that dismissed the co‑founders’ attempt to quash a securities fraud investigation.
